from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A judgment document with its case type, cause of action, and any criminal charges."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The general case type (e.g., '民事', '刑事', '行政')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The primary cause of action or legal issue as stated")
    crime_types: list[str] | None = Field(description="Any criminal charges or crimes named in this document")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the case type and cause of action")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
